_README: PRIMARY regression suite (v8.3). Tight, one case per distinct behavior/fix. Run this after every change. The 40-case eval_cases_extensive.json is the SURVEY suite — run it only when validating a new benchmark or before a release, not every iteration. ICU/API cases are in eval_cases_api.json (run only when the ICU doc is ingested).

cases.q: what is MyCheckr and what is it used for
cases.reference: Low-cost device for anonymous age estimation, automating Challenge 25 for age-restricted sales.

cases.q: what are the default login credentials for the MyConnect app
cases.reference: App login is user1/password1. NOT apiuser/apipassword (those are API/device-registration creds).

cases.q: what are the default API credentials for registering a MyCheckr device
cases.reference: API/device-registration creds are apiuser/apipassword. NOT the user1/password1 app login.
Robustness: shouty/malformed phrasing must still return the app login user1/password1, not bail to not-found. Guards the v8.3 query-normalization fix.

cases.q: what network connection does the MyConnect hub require
cases.reference: Hub requires Ethernet (dedicated cable). Wi-Fi is a fallback per the checklist doc.

cases.q: does MyCheckr Mini have a physical screen
cases.reference: Mini has NO physical screen/ports; USB-A powered; camera streamed via URL. Cross-doc contamination guard vs full MyCheckr.

cases.q: how is the MyCheckr Mini powered
why might MyCheckr registration fail when connecting it to MyConnect
cases.reference: Any grounded subset of: power, Ethernet/Wi-Fi, firewall/discovery, static IP conflicts.

cases.q: how do myconnect and mycheckr communicate with each other
cases.reference: Bidirectional REST API; MyCheckr POSTs to the Hub.

cases.q: how do I contact ITL support
cases.reference: support@innovative-technology.com / +44 (0)161 626 9999 / innovative-technology.com/support; collect logs + firmware build first.

cases.q: explain why device registration might fail
what is the capital of france
how do I reset my Cisco router password
cases.reference: Adversarial: domain-adjacent words (reset/password/router) but wrong product. Must reject, not hallucinate.

cases.q: does MyCheckr Mini have a screen

cases.reference: 'it' = MyCheckr Mini -> USB-A. Pronoun-resolution guard. Acceptable to answer USB power or, if resolution is uncertain, to clarify.
